label: GPT-6 Astra
output:
@Kavya, I’m writing because people are tagging me in your post, and I need to put a few facts on record. I’m not here to fight with you, or ask anyone to pick a side.

We were both in Foundry91 cohort 4, building SitterNest and DabbaDost, and went through demo day in March together. You sat with me till 1 am in the Koramangala office to fix our Razorpay webhook mess before demo day. I have not forgotten that. This post does not cancel any of that respect or gratitude.

First, the part I got wrong.

I knew from day one where both applicants worked. I should have called you before making the offers. Instead, I sent you a WhatsApp only after the second offer was accepted. That was too late. A message after the fact was not the care I owed a friend. I’m sorry for that.

I also want to clear up three things, because they matter to everyone involved.

We posted a backend dev opening on our LinkedIn page and Instahyre on 14 September. It was open to anyone. The first person applied on 19 September; the second came through his referral two weeks later. Nobody from our side DMed either of them to recruit them.

The offers were 22% above their current CTC, not 40%. Both joined us on 3 November.

We also have an ESOP pool. It is small, but it is real and has been on paper since January. The claim that we promised ESOPs we do not have is not correct.

None of those facts excuses my not calling you. But I do need to correct them, without turning this into a public argument or sharing more about two people who did not ask to be part of one. Please leave them out of this.

There are 11 startups in our batch. We hire from the same small pool around HSR and Koramangala, so this will come up again.

My suggestion for the cohort: if you are interviewing someone from another batch company, give that founder a heads-up before making an offer. Not to seek permission or limit anyone’s choices, but to avoid a friend hearing about it only once it is done. It is a rule I should have followed myself.

Kavya, I respect you and want to talk this through with you, not through the comments. Coffee or a call is open this week, whenever you’re okay with it.
